subject: 🏃 Monday — Hip & Core A (Add Load, Week 3)
html:
Today: Hip & Core A — Week 3 of 4, Chassis Build. 11 days to PT follow-up (May 15).

This is the session where we start adding light load — hip airplane picks up a 5 lb DB, and Copenhagen plank progresses from 20 to 30-second holds. But I need to flag something first: your April 29, May 1, and May 3 runs all have pending knee status, and the Strava data raises concerns. You ran 5.79 mi on Wednesday (a Mobility Deep-Dive day) at 8:13/mi with HR 148, and 5.08 mi on Friday (a Hip & Core B day) at 7:45/mi with HR 152 — both over the Chassis Build pace/HR ceiling (all easy, HR <140) and on days scheduled for gym work, not running. If those runs replaced your Hip & Core B and Mobility sessions, that's a real problem — the hip and core work IS the training right now, and the marathon build starting May 18 depends on the chassis being ready.

I'm programming today assuming knee green (last confirmed Apr 24 was green), but send me knee feedback on those three runs today so I can adjust the rest of the week if needed.

Focus cue: Copenhagen plank — keep the top hip stacked directly over the bottom. The moment it rolls back, adductors take over and the core stops working. Hold 30 seconds each side today (up from 20).

Daily Mobility Flush (~12 min) — do this first:

  • Foam roller T-spine extensions (PT): 8–10 reps
  • Standing lunges with hip IR + extension (PT): 8–10 reps each side
  • World's greatest stretch: 5 each side
  • 90/90 hip stretch (IR emphasis): 60 sec each side
  • Half-kneeling couch stretch: 60 sec each side
  • Hip CARs: 3 each direction, each leg
  • Cat-cow: 10 reps

Session Warm-up (10 min):

  • Foam roll: IT band, TFL, glutes, quads, adductors — 30 sec each, both sides
  • Quadruped banded hip IR / lateral band pull (PT): 8 reps each side
  • Banded hip distraction with IR emphasis: 90 sec each side
  • 90/90 transitions: 10 reps
  • Glute bridges (banded above knees): 15 reps, 2-sec squeeze at top

Main Circuit — 3 rounds:

ExerciseWeightSets × Reps
90/90 PAILs/RAILs (hip IR isometric)Bodyweight3 × 10 sec each direction, each side
Side-lying clamshell (banded)Light band15 each side, 2-sec hold at top
Single-leg glute bridgeBodyweight12 each side, 2-sec hold
Hip airplane5 lb DB (new — front hand)8 each side
Copenhagen plankBodyweight30 sec each side (up from 20)
Dead bug — slow march w/ banded pulldown (PT)Light band overhead2–3 sets × 10 marches
Chin tuck + lifts — front & diagonal (PT)Bodyweight2 reps each direction, 3-sec hold
Pallof press (isometric hold)Light band3 × 15 sec each side

Finisher:

  • Wall sit: 45 sec × 3
  • Terminal knee extension (TKE), right leg only: 3 × 15 (light band)

Cool-down:

  • Pigeon pose: 60 sec each side
  • Couch stretch: 60 sec each side
